reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Mathematical impossibility: Phase 03 claims that when `blob_retention_epoch > fulu_fork_epoch`, line 829 can return a value < `fulu_fork_epoch`. However, the condition `blob_retention_epoch > fulu_fork_epoch` translates to `current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS > fulu_fork_epoch`, which means `current_epoch > fulu_fork_epoch + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS`. Since line 829 returns `current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS`, and in all configurations `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS <= MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` (mainnet: 4096/4096, Gnosis: 4096/16384), the result is always >= `fulu_fork_epoch`. Spec INV-006 from SG-008 confirms the boundary should be max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), and the code correctly enforces this through the conditional structure. No attack window exists.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P spec SG-008 (data_column_sidecars_by_range) INV-006: data_column_serve_range = [max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), current_epoch]
